verdict.rationale: Orb's essential dunning automatically retries a failed charge on a fixed schedule of 1, 4 and 9 days after the initial attempt, when payment attempts are enabled. That covers automatic scheduled retries. Nothing shows the cadence is ML-driven, optimized or configurable, and nothing reports recovery of involuntary churn. Missing for 10: ML/smart or configurable retry optimization, recovery-rate reporting or measured churn-recovery outcomes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn

citations.quote: If payment attempts is enabled and the initial attempt fails, Orb will automatically retry the charge after 1, 4, and 9 days from the initial payment attempt.
